items.title: Dior Holders to Vote on Agache Merger as LVMH Shares Sag on US Wealth Jitters
items.why: Softer US wealth sentiment hitting LVMH shares is a signal to watch for affluent luxury demand.
items.summary_ai: Dior shareholders will vote on a merger with Agache as LVMH shares fall on US wealth concerns.

items.title: Dior Board Clears Agache Merger, Handing LVMH a New Ownership Structure
items.why: Ownership consolidation at a major luxury house can shift partnership priorities, so track who controls LVMH brand decisions.
items.summary_ai: Dior's board approved a merger with Agache, changing the ownership structure within LVMH.
items.take: Ownership consolidation at a major luxury house can shift partnership priorities, so track who controls LVMH brand decisions.
